title: The Top of the Lid Ruined by an Unnecessary Adhesive Label
text:
The Top of the Lid Ruined by an Unnecessary Adhesive Label. I have attached a picture of the adhesive label they stick on the very top. I am not exaggerating when I say it cannot be easily removed. It is stuck on there so powerfully, it just will not peel off without destroying it and leaving behind discoloration and scratches and marks.

I do not recommend buying this unless the manufacturer either utilizes easily removable adhesive labels, or decides no adhesive labels at all. They could simply attach a tag to the handle with either plastic or rope.
